description: This file contains utility functions related to game physics and entity management for the Unvanquished game, including trajectory calculations, entity description building, structure identification, bounding box center movement, flag modifications, and vector/angle conversions.

methods.name: BG_GetTrajectoryPitch
methods.description: Calculates two possible pitch angles and directions for a projectile to reach a target on a parabolic trajectory given origin, target, initial velocity, and gravity.

methods.name: BG_BuildEntityDescription
methods.description: Builds a string description of an entity based on its entity state.

methods.name: BG_IsMainStructure
methods.description: Determines if a buildable or entity is a main structure (Overmind or Reactor).

methods.name: BG_MoveOriginToBBOXCenter
methods.description: Moves a point to the center of a bounding box defined by mins and maxs.

methods.name: ModifyFlag
methods.description: Sets or clears a specific flag in a flags variable based on a boolean value.

methods.name: AngleVectors
methods.description: Computes forward, right, and up vectors from yaw, pitch, and roll angles.

methods.name: RotationMatrix
methods.description: Creates a rotation matrix from angles, using AngleVectors.

methods.name: ProjectPointOntoVectorBounded
methods.description: Projects a point onto a vector segment, bounded by start and end points.

methods.name: ProjectPointOnPlane
methods.description: Projects a point onto a plane defined by a normal vector.

methods.name: PerpendicularVector
methods.description: Returns a vector perpendicular to the given normalized vector.

methods.name: vectoangles
methods.description: Converts a direction vector into pitch and yaw angles.
